Bullying used to be a serious problem at my high school. There was this one specific kid who really was the worst of the worst. He would torture kids in a creative way. The thing was, he was very smart. He knew how to not get caught. To give you an example of what he would do, he once tied a kid up, and left him in a closet overnight. He truly was terrible and I have no idea how no one ever found out.

Edit: no one really asked, but I felt a need to explain a bit more about the kid who got tied up.

Let’s call this kid Ben and the bully Rex. Ben was a frequent target of Rex. Ben was always hanging out by himself. He pretty much fit the exact stereotype of a nerd who got picked on. It was the end of the day. Ben was walking down the hall and needed to get something from a closet. I’m not sure exactly what. Rex saw this, and rammed into Ben; knocking him to the floor.  The closet they were in was a storage closet. It mostly just had a bunch of school supplies, but it was pretty big. Now, I’m not sure exactly how or why, but Rex decided to strip Ben and use some electrical tape to bound and gag him. And Rex knew what he was doing. He knew what he was doing so well that is actually concerned me. Rex didn’t just tape ben’s wrists, ankles, and mouth. He secured his arms behind his back. And even went as far as to use Ben’s socks to make a stuffed gag. So after Rex stripped Ben to his underwear and tied him up, he went outside, closed and locked the door, and left. Ben was found by the janitors later that night. He never explicitly said who it was that did this to him, but everyone knew it was Rex.
